The main difference between a Python list and a dictionary is that a list is a mutable object, whereas a dictionary is an unordered collection of key-value pairs. Lists are defined by a sequence of elements, whereas dictionaries are defined by a set of key-value pairs. Lists can be modified after creation, whereas dictionaries cannot be modified after creation (although you can add new key-value pairs).
